layout: One column. Hero: the weekday large, the date, and a done count beside a side-on chain meter (one link per habit, lit when done), then one computed insight line (a run at risk, a new best). Then one tap tile per habit (two across on desktop), a streak shown only when there is one, and a quiet dashed 'Add a habit' row. Below: the Chains board, a panel with a name column and a five-week, Monday-aligned day grid on a shared axis (stacked on phones).
signature: Streak chains: consecutive check-ins merge into one violet capsule labelled with its length (the live run solid, past runs pale). A missed day is an empty grey cell, days before tracking are faint dots, today's open day is a dashed amber slot on an amber column, and the rest of the week sits outlined ahead. The hero repeats the idea as a side-on chain of links for today.
